stops.name: Vallon de la Tièche
stops.quote: A guide from the Pfyn-Finges Nature Park will tell you the great story of water in the Vallon de la Tièche: wars, waterfalls and water distribution.
stops.english: A guide from the Pfyn-Finges Nature Park will tell you the great story of water in the Vallon de la Tièche: wars, waterfalls and water distribution.

stops.name: Albinen
stops.quote: Albinen, in the heart of the Pfyn-Finges Nature Park: enjoy plenty of sun, views over the Rhône Valley, hikes, winter sports, and wellness in nearby Leukerbad.
stops.english: Albinen, in the heart of the Pfyn-Finges Nature Park: enjoy plenty of sun, views over the Rhône Valley, hikes, winter sports, and wellness in nearby Leukerbad.

stops.name: Salgesch
stops.quote: In the winegrowing village of Salgesch in the middle of the Pfyn-Finges Nature Park, Luc Mounir and his family grow top-quality wines.
stops.english: In the winegrowing village of Salgesch in the middle of the Pfyn-Finges Nature Park, Luc Mounir and his family grow top-quality wines.

stops.name: Leuk
stops.quote: The small medieval town of Leuk can be found amidst hillside vineyards above the Rhône Valley in the canton of Valais.
stops.english: The small medieval town of Leuk can be found amidst hillside vineyards above the Rhône Valley in the canton of Valais.

stops.name: Pfyn-Finges Forest
stops.quote: It offers beautiful views of the Pfyn-Finges Forest and is known for its variety of towers.
stops.english: It offers beautiful views of the Pfyn-Finges Forest and is known for its variety of towers.

stops.name: Varen
stops.quote: Fantastic views from the hill-top church at Varen.
stops.english: Fantastic views from the hill-top church at Varen.

stops.name: Rhone Route
stops.quote: The Rhone Route runs through the magnificent mountain scenery of the Valais on charming, quiet paths along the Rhone.
stops.english: The Rhone Route runs through the magnificent mountain scenery of the Valais on charming, quiet paths along the Rhone.
